name: merge_task
title: Merge a task
description: Start merging the card's approved commit into its repository's default branch. The result arrives as a team message. Call again to retry a failed or blocked merge.

fix_conflict.description: After a conflict failure, request a writable merge-fix worktree. Your session restarts when this turn ends.

resolution.description: While fixing: describe what and where you resolved, after committing the mechanical conflict resolution.
